== Original post ==

'''EBO And X-wings It's All Good v 2'''
* '''Author:''' 3 legged "MeatDonkey" donkey
* '''Published:''' November 12, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 2.0
* '''Description:''' Just a revised version of my deck that doesn't start ANSB.

=== Strategy ===

First thing to do is pull the generals and then activate. Then use Insurrection to look for a docking bay and to check whats in your force pile. If you drew a signal or ANSB play it and get what you need. If it all goes right you should always have it set up second turn. On the second turn all you need to grab is EBO, if you didnt draw it. Get Incom Corp. out quick. Use the Baragwins and Figrin Dan to retrieve your cards. The catapults are in there just for the destiny. Drawing a 7 really hurts the other guy. I hevnt taken this to any tourneys or anything yet, so any advice is appreciated.
